description.en: E-Bench evaluates multi-step tool-use agents in synthetic state-changing tasks across three product domains: Honor of Kings, QQ Music, and Tencent Meeting. It requires agents to discover hidden information and compose multiple tool calls before changing state, with deterministic grading by database-state diffs.

evidence.snippet: We introduce E-Bench, a fully synthetic benchmark with 323 state-changing tasks across three product domains: Honor of Kings, QQ Music, and Tencent Meeting.
